scope: Software-only browser tests with an injected mock serial stream. NOT tested with an Arduino or pump.
checks: Original landing page is preserved and explicitly labelled concept data
Initial state has no generated real measurements
Explicit demo is clearly labelled synthetic
CSV is downloadable and retains synthetic source label
Mock serial port opens at 115200
Partial data line does not update measurements
Legacy numeric firmware is accepted without fabricated GPIO
Malformed lines are counted and not rendered as values
Stale data is hidden and recording ends, without demo fallback
Read failure closes unlocked stream and leaves offline UI
Reconnect clears previous measurements and statistics
Telemetry displays commanded LOW, not an inferred pump or pressure
Duplicate sample in a GPIO/status frame does not add chart sample
A confirmed HIGH to LOW edge is counted once
Firmware reboot clears live data and ends current recording
Manual disconnect releases read lock before close
Production transport never requested serial writable stream
Port chooser cancellation returns a usable disconnected UI
Records keep USB and synthetic sessions separate
Caregiver overview is still explicitly example data
Mobile hardware page does not overflow horizontally
Browser without Web Serial shows actionable fallback message
No uncaught JavaScript errors across routes and stream lifecycle
